_comment: giscus config for the review site's comment boxes. Until repoId and categoryId are filled in, every page renders a labelled placeholder instead of the embed -- the site is fully reviewable without them. To wire comments up: enable Discussions on Frankfurt-AI-Safety/rm-bias-experiment-review, add a category, install the giscus GitHub App (https://giscus.app), paste the two ids it issues below, and rebuild. No code change is needed.
